decisions.decision: Treat a logical session as active only when its authoritative connected flag is true.
decisions.why: This matches the accepted specification assumption and keeps recognized disconnected sessions available only in the detailed dialog.
decisions.rejected: Counting every recognized session regardless of current connectivity.

decisions.decision: Use a native modal dialog and keep the existing logical-session row template and command handlers.
decisions.why: Native modality provides focus containment and Escape behavior while preserving every established management operation.
decisions.rejected: Create a second session model or duplicate the management implementation.

implement.summary: Moved logical-session details and all existing controls into a reactive accessible dialog while leaving only the connected-session count in the main Overseer panel.
